role: Known-answer test vectors for the five lightweight AEAD schemes added in the extended comparison

lwc-finalists.role: Reference C implementations and generated KAT files for all ten NIST Lightweight Cryptography finalists

vector_format: Count / Key / Nonce / PT / AD / CT blocks; every plaintext length 0-32 x every AD length 0-32
aes_128_ccm_note: AES-128-CCM has no NIST-LWC vector file. Its pure-Python implementation is validated by exact byte-for-byte agreement with OpenSSL (via the cryptography package) over randomised inputs; see tests/test_lightweight_kat.py.
